description: This dataset contains high-resolution geochemical measurements from Porites sp. coral cores collected at a single site in French Polynesia, identified as TIAREI-3B. The records span recent years, with Age_2 values ranging from 2001 to 2007, providing a detailed temporal context for climate reconstruction. Key variables include elemental ratios like Strontium-to-Calcium and Magnesium-to-Calcium, alongside stable isotope ratios of oxygen and carbon, which serve as proxies for past sea surface temperatures and environmental conditions. All samples share consistent geographic coordinates and an elevation of -15 meters. Researchers can utilize this data to analyze seasonal climate variability, validate paleoclimate models, and understand the geochemical responses of coral ecosystems to changing oceanic conditions.
